Image 3 is the original photograph, for local texture and depth of field only. Refine ONLY the already inserted Joe Burrow in image 1, in his current exact location, body and head size. His current face looks too crisp and like a posed studio portrait compared to the surrounding fans. Give him a subtle candid smile and a slight three-quarter gaze toward the action, faithfully preserving recognizable Joe Burrow facial structure. Integrate his face, hair, ears, neck, and connected Bengals fan clothes naturally. Match the noticeably SOFT FOCUS and low microcontrast of other heads at the same depth, local light direction and color temperature. Do not make Joe any sharper, brighter, or larger than the immediately neighboring faces. Keep the foreground occlusions, all other people, all text and logos, overall framing and original photograph unchanged. Output only the clean image, no boxes, arrows, labels or collage.
